entities.name: Aspartate-tRNA ligase
observations: The 589-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q5WHP3 from Shouchella clausii.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent attachment of L-aspartate to tRNA(Asp), forming aspartyl-tRNA(Asp) through an Asp-AMP intermediate.
Predicted/annotated as a homodimeric cytoplasmic enzyme.
Pfam supports an N-terminal tRNA anticodon-recognition region (PF01336) and a class-II aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase catalytic domain (PF00152).
Sequence-derived molecular mass is approximately 66.7 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.37.

entities.name: Aspartyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: Aspartate-tRNA ligase supports cytoplasmic charging of tRNA(Asp), supplying correctly aminoacylated tRNA for translation and protein synthesis.

entities.name: Aspartate-tRNA charging
observations: tRNA(Asp) + L-aspartate + ATP produces L-aspartyl-tRNA(Asp) + AMP + diphosphate via an aspartyl-AMP intermediate; Rhea RHEA:19649.
The sequence-level evidence supports canonical tRNA(Asp) specificity; relaxed tRNA(Asn) charging is not established for this exact sequence despite being present in some homologs.
